text: A hinge pushes your hips back with soft knees. It trains your hamstrings, glutes, and back.

The conventional deadlift lets you lift the most. The Romanian deadlift gives your hamstrings a big stretch. The trap bar deadlift is easier on your back. And back extensions are a great place to start.
Learn the hinge with Romanian deadlifts before you go heavy.
